channel.title: Equatorial Guinea - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Equatorial Guinea, every source cited.

item.title: GETESA discusses AI impact at Malabo conference
item.description: The telecommunications firm shared insights on artificial intelligence in human resources and business efficiency.

item.title: Equatorial Guinea trains border staff for African trade zone
item.description: A workshop in Malabo aimed to equip customs and trade officials with skills to boost cross-border commerce.

item.title: Malabo drivers face fuel queues again
item.description: Long lines of vehicles at TotalEnergies in Semu signal potential new fuel shortages.

item.title: MYCHIC Project boosts entrepreneurs in Malabo
item.description: The initiative focuses on entrepreneurial mindset, financial education, and digital marketing for business growth.

item.title: BEAC denies issuing new CFA franc banknotes
item.description: The Bank of Central African States confirmed that images of new banknotes circulating on social media are false.
